Scene: wide establishing shot of Gas City, a floating sky town of white stone towers with teal glass domes, linked by transparent glass air pipes, with windmills and small waterfalls. Late afternoon, overcast amber sky. The giant glowing Air Core in the center has just gone dim: its blue light is faint, the glass pipes are dark, the windmills are frozen. In the foreground on a stone terrace stand two worried characters seen from behind at three-quarter view, looking toward the core: Air, an upright orange fox inventor with brass aviator goggles on his head, a cream shirt, a teal vest with a brass gear badge, a brown satchel and big brass boots; and a 10-year-old boy with messy brown hair, brass goggles with teal lenses on his head, a cream shirt, a dark teal vest, brown shorts and a brown backpack. Far away on a rooftop, small and half-hidden, a round red balloon-like mischief creature with blue hose arms holding a little pinwheel peeks out. Leave the upper-left third calm and simple. Match the characters to the attached reference images exactly.

Scene: inside the cozy Weight Laboratory of Gas City, warm daylight through tall arched windows that show glass air pipes outside. On a wooden workbench stands a brass and teal balance scale with a sealed clear glass jar on one pan, a small hand air pump connected to the jar by a thin tube, and a level bubble gauge. Lumi, a small cream-beige cat researcher with large brass goggles on her forehead, a teal-and-cream striped outfit and a brown pouch with a gold paw emblem, carefully places the jar on the scale. Beside her, the 10-year-old boy hero (messy brown hair, brass goggles with teal lenses on his head, cream shirt, dark teal vest, brown backpack) holds a blank clipboard and leans in with curious eyes.
